summary: Flathead County lookout on Haskell Mountain: log cabin by 1927, 10-foot tower by 1961, staffed in newspapers 1936-1967, gone by 1997; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Firelookout.com dates its end to 1997 without saying how it went

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1936-1938 items and firelookout.com use Haskell Mountain or Haskill Mtn.; the 1961-1967 Courier items say Haskell Pass lookout near Marion and out of Kila. The sources do not say they are the same station, so the story says so and does not merge them.
Firelookout.com names the Montana DNRC; the 1936-1938 staffing was by the Northern Montana Forestry association. Both are reported; the sources do not say how the agency changed.

notes_for_editor: Name: the newspapers and the Weebly page spell it Haskell; firelookout.com uses Haskill. The record keeps Haskill; consider Haskell if the editor agrees. Haskell Pass (Wikipedia, 48.163 N, 114.747 W) is about 19 km from the record's coordinates and was not used; the Courier 'Haskell Pass lookout' may or may not be this site. No height in any source; the brief has none. No photos found. Site today: no source found in two searches.
